10.85. Repeal.

Ordinance Nos. 550, 556, 620, 631, 639, 727, 783, 820, 828, 829, 843, 877, 939, 952, 1025, 1044, 1059, 1086, 1123, 1141, 1193, 1249, 1394, 1427, 1485, 1498, 1499, 1520, 1600, 1660, 1724, 1737, 1743, 1795, 1900, 1913, 1933, 2001, 2063, 3018, 3030, 3032, 3039, 3058 and 3067 are repealed.
Effective on: 3/20/1998
